notes.title: The journey continues Hero World 2 has arrived!
notes.notes:
If you enjoyed the first game, you're going to love the sequel: new levels, more outfits, checkpoints, refined gameplay, and much more.
Hero World 2 is now available on Steam and ready for your next adventure with Tom and Lisa!

[u]Check it out and start playing now![/u]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3445550/Hero_World_2/

notes.title: Hero World 2 – Official Release Announcement
notes.notes:
[u][b]Hero World 2 launches on May 13, 2025![/b][/u]

The adventure continues! Join Tom and Lisa as they return in Hero World 2. Add the game to your wishlist now and don’t miss the release!

📅 [b]May 13, 2025 – Be ready![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3445550/Hero_World_2/

notes.title: Hero World Small Update
notes.notes:
[u][b]Jump Pad Optimization[/b][/u]

The Jump Pad has been overhauled and improved:

Sound issue fixed:
[list]
[*] A bug where the Jump Pad sound was played twice has been resolved. The sound effect now plays only once as intended.
[/list]

This update ensures smooth and error-free usage of the Jump Pad, enhancing the overall player experience.

notes.title: Hero World Update
notes.notes:
[u][b]Update:[/b][/u]

[u][b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/u]

[u]Sound Loading Issue Resolved:[/u]
[list]
[*] A bug causing sound settings not to apply correctly after death or restarting a level has been fixed. Sound adjustments now persist reliably without requiring a return to the main menu.
[/list]

[u][b]Improvements:[/b][/u]

[u]Enhanced Chest Shop:[/u]
[list]
[*] Chests no longer open automatically when approached. Players now have full control and can manually open chests using the Enter key on the keyboard or the B button on the controller.
[/list]

[u][b]New Content:[/b][/u]

[u]In-Level Music:[/u]
[list]
[*] To enhance the atmosphere, new music tracks have been added to the game levels. A total of 3 new tracks provide a more engaging and varied experience.
[/list]

notes.title: Hero World Discord Server
notes.notes:
We are excited to introduce our new Discord server from Hero World to you! On our server, you can meet other players and talk about the game. You also have access to all the news and updates about the game. We encourage you to share your ideas and suggestions with the community. We believe you can help us make the game even better!

On our server, we also provide a specific channel for bugs and issues, so you can reach out to us if you encounter any problems. We are always striving to make the game as error-free as possible, and your help is invaluable. We look forward to developing the game together with you.

Our Hero World Discord server is a lively community platform where you can meet other players and exchange ideas with like-minded people. We place great importance on providing a friendly and respectful environment for everyone on our server. We hope you will feel comfortable with us and participate in our discussions.

In summary, on our Hero World Discord server, you can discuss the game, share ideas and suggestions, report bugs and issues, and meet a friendly community. We would be delighted if you joined our server and became part of our community!


Discord Link: https://discord.gg/q73VZCYFGS
